Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well. Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

Viral Chocolate box cake✨🍫🍰 #yellowboxcake #bettycrocker #yellowcakechocolatefrosting #boxcake #dessert Ingredients: • 1 box Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix or Butter Recipe Yellow Cake mix  • 4 eggs • 1 stick unsalted butter, melted • 1 cup buttermilk or milk • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 container Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting Instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix, 4 eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. 2. Mix until smooth and well combined. 3. Pour the batter into a greased 9x11 baking pan. 4. Bake at 315°F for 37 minutes. 5. Let the cake cool completely. 6. Microwave the Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting for 15–20 seconds until pourable (warm, not hot). 7. Pour the frosting over the cake, making sure to cover all the corners evenly. 8. Let the frosting set for 1–2 hours. 9. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

STOP 🛑 everything you’re doing and make this 5-ingredient apple blender cake! 🍎 Link to all products used here https://www.amazon.com/shop/sivanskitchen/photo/amzn1.shoppablemedia.v1.45bca6da-246a-4a42-8bdb-f33a112f24c7?ref_=aipsfphoto Simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and the result is the fluffiest, most delicious apple cake. Everything goes straight into the blender, and you’re done! Top it however you like, but melted Lotus Biscoff cookie butter with crushed pecans takes it to another level.  Bake in any pan of your choice✨ 5-INGREDIENT APPLE CAKE🍎 Ingredients • 1 medium-large apple, cut into chunks (I used Honeycrisp, but any apple works) • 3 large eggs • ¾ cup sugar (135 g) • ½ cup oil (120 ml) • 1½ cups self-rising flour (210 g) Optional: • 1 additional apple, peel on, cut into small chunks Flour Substitutions: • Gluten-free: 2 cups almond flour (180 g) + 1 tsp baking powder • All-purpose flour: 1½ cups (210 g) + 1 tsp baking powder For Topping: • Melted Biscoff cookie butter • Crushed pecans • Powdered sugar, optional Instructions 	1.	Wash and scrub the first apple. Peel if desired, then cut into chunks. 	2.	Add the apple, sugar, eggs and oil to a blender. Blend until completely smooth. 	3.	Add the flour and pulse only twice. Do not over-blend. Overmixing can make the cake dense instead of light and tender. 	4.	If using the additional apple, cut it into small chunks with the peel on and gently fold it into the finished batter. 	5.	Grease or spray your baking pan and pour in the batter. 	6.	Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 45 minutes, depending on your pan. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out clean. 	7.	Allow to cool. Warm the Biscoff cookie butter until pourable, drizzle it over the cake and finish with crushed pecans. Freezes beautifully! 💛 Shana Tova umetukah🍯🐝 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #applecake #apple #holidays

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies.
